title: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
summary_full: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.
summary_public: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.
